content: Stiven-me agale lisa
Go lisimi rabu Gote-na lodo kira-ae ali kalunumi Stiven lorapisimi: Nimumi ne-para lamede agalere ora leme pe lisimi.
Stiven-me go remaa gu-rupa abulisa: Amenu aapanu, pagalepape. Naana kasua Abraham Haran su-para na-pirisa rabu epe paa pi Gote-me Mesopotemia su-para opapaoma agale gu-rupa lakalisa:
Nena su-para piri ruru giyoma su rado-para pope. Go suri neme waatoa.
Go lisa-pulu Abraham Kaldia su giyoma Haran su-nane pisa. Go puma nipuna aaraa komenaloma Gote-me nipu go su-para ma epenalisa. Nimi abi go pimi su madaa talo.

Go rabu Gote-me Abraham nipuna surubape su kalisa. Dia, nipuna kama agu raapu pirape oge regepele su-daa nakalisa. Yapare Gote-me werepe Abraham nipuna sinu-para rurunu-para minalo ora agale lakalisa. Gote-me go-rupa lakalisa raburi Abraham-me naaki meda abi namaitisa.
Gote-me gu-rupa wala lakalisa: Nena werepe madi naakina rurunuri pa kimisu naakinu ruru piruma nimu ora kogono madaa adili ali-rupa piralimi. Go puma nimu ora maali 400 koe-rupa piralimi lisa.

Gore Gote-me Abraham-para wala lakalisa: Apo ada kimisu-para piri gavman-mere nena naakina rurunu kogono madaa adiala surubalimi. Go palimi pare neme koe kedaa abulanoloma nena madina rurunu ne piri-para nina bi minasaatalo epalimi lisa.

Go loma lisana Gote-me Abraham yogale ruguli kone kalisa. Go pisa-pulu Abraham-me Aisak madisa rabu yapi 8 piruma go naakina yogale rugulisa. Go puma werepe Aisak Jekop madisa. Jekop-mere naana kasua 12 madisa.

Stiven-me agale gu-rupa lakalisa: Jekop-na sinumi Josep-para koe kone suma Isip yoto muma kimisu kogono ali-rupa maa puma yoto misimi. Yapare Gote-me Josep raapu piruma kedaa epalia lo surubisa. Go rabu Fero ora Isip-na ali mudu pirisa. Go puma Josep kabesimi rabu Gote-me Josep epe makuaae kone kalisa.
Nipumi go kone kalisa-pulu Fero-me Josep-para epe kone suma Josep ora Isip su raayona namba wan gavman ali mapiraasa. Go puma nipuna ada page surubenalo surube ali mapiraasa.
Go pisa-le Isip su-para Kenan su laapo-para reae adaa paboma sapi e poape giya komisimi. Go pisimi rabu naana kasuanu eda asa pisimi.
Go pisa rabu naana kasua Jekop-me Isip su-para eda salo remaa pagoma nipuna sinu rana komea pora kimisu-para ma rapasa.
Rana laapo pisimi rabu Josep-me ameaya-para nipuna kone lakalisa rabu Fero-me Josep nipuna ruru adisa.
Go pisa rabu Josep-me nipuna aaraa Jekop-para agale rapaoma nipuna ruru Isip su-para ipulupape lo lakalisa. Go pisa rabu enaali 75 no-para puma ipisimi.
Go pisa rabu Jekop Isip su-para puma komenaloma naana kasuanu page go su-para puma komisimi.
Komenaloma nimuna ronu Sikem su-para mea ria puma rogaasimi. Go suri Abraham-me ali rogaape tapa kabenalo Hamo-na naakinu kana kalisa.
Go pisa pare Gote-me Abraham-para pogalu pirape agale kalenalo di rudu lisa rabu naana ruru enaali adaapu Isip su-para kimisu puma pirisimi.
Go-para pirisimi pare werepere Isip-na ali mudu meda piruma go alimi Josep na-adisa.
Go ali mudumi naana ruru yala mapolaaoma kasuanu radaa mapaaoma nimuna nogo naaki pa komenalo su kamaa-nane mea mapiraasa.
Go rabu Moses-na agimi nipu madisa. Go naakiri le-wili kaapu epe-rupa ae naaki yaa-pulu agimi suba repo ada-para madu saapirisa. Go pisa pare werepe nipu kalae naaki-rupa pirisa.
Go rabu ali mudu Fero-na waneme muma ora nipuna si-rupa surubisa.
Go rabu Isip kone makuaae alinumi nipu mogealisimi. Go pisa-pulu Moses-ri nipu yaba yapipi le ali piruma puri pale agaa-para kogono-para puma ali mudu-rupa pirisa.
Wala werepe Moses-na maali 40 palinaloma nipumi Israel su-para piri amenu adalua kone wisa.
Go pisa rabu Moses-me Isip ali medame ame ralu talaina adisa. Adisa-pulu nipumi ame raba mulalo puma nipumi Isip ali lu makomeama rudu abulisa.
Go pisa rabu Moses-me kone gu-rupa wisa: Gote-me ni puri ginalo neme amenu raba mealua rabu adalimi kone wisa. Go kone wisa pare amenumi kone gu-rupa nawisimi.
Wala ekera-nanere ame laapome yada pisipi rabu Moses adoma yada napipape lo agale gu-rupa lakalisa: Ame laapo, nipiri ora ameaya-le nipimi ake paa-daa makoyaaripi ya?
Go lisa pare mo alimi rono pagoma go Moses warolo paoma talo: Aapimi ne ora ali mudu-rupa mapiraaripa ya?
Abala go Isip ali meda tyade-rupa ni tyalalo pi pae?
Gu-rupa pagisa rabu Moses paala komoma Midian su-para pogola puma yada tyape ali-rupa puma pirisa. Go puma werepere nipumi naaki laapo madisa.
Maali 40 palisa rabu Moses enaali napiri su Rudu Sainai re-para puma ensel meda adisa. Adisa rabu repena sulaa ralae-na adisa.
Moses-me adisa rabu nipumi pala komoma rabu nipu re-para puma adolalo pisa. Go rabu nipumi Mudu Ali-na agale gu-rupa pagisa:
Niri nena kasuanuna Gote yaade. Niri Abraham-para Aisak-para Jekop-para nimuna Gote yaade lisa. Go lisa rabu Moses paala komoma pururu pisa pare Gote piri-para na-adisa.
Go pisa rabu Gote-me nipu-para talo: Nena age ada koyape. Abi ne rekoma aate suri ora Gote-na epe su yaade lisa.
Neme nina Isip su-para piri enaalinuna koe radaa pi kogono-daa ora ade. Nimuna re pagoma nimu raba mulalo epawa. Go pea-le ne rekoma ne Isip su-para painalo pi lisa.

Go Moses komeare Israel su-para piri enaalinumi abala giyoma gu-rupa lisimi: Aapimi ne ali mudu-para kose pagape ali-rupa mapiraaripa pae? Go lisimi pare Gote-me Moses ali mudu-para raba mi ali-para pirinalo mea rapasa. Go repena sulaa ralae-para pirisa ensel-me Moses raba minalo Gote-me Moses puri mapabaasa.
Moses-mere Isip su-para napi kogono page rado kogononu page pisa. Nipumi enaalinu Kale Ipa kenaoma enaali napiri su-para maali 40 nimu surubisa.
Moses-miri Israel su-para piri enaali abala gu-rupa lakalisa: Gote-me ni mapiraasa-rupa nimina rikirana agale lakale ali meda mapiraalia.

Moses-re Israel su-para piri enaalinu kiritasimi rabu nipumi raba misa. Nipumi ensel raapu Rudu Sainai madaa piruma agale lakalisa. Go ensel-me kasuanu page agale lakalisa. Apo ade abuna mapiraape agale pagisimi rabu nimi page pagaliminalo lagisa.
Go pisa pare go Moses-re naana kasuanumi koau rilalisimi. Nimimi nipu giyoma wala Isip su-para palima kone wisimi.
Go puma nimumi Aron gu-rupa lakalisimi: Remo medaloma wari lisimi. Go puma nimumi pora walenaloma werepe pomona. Moses-re naa Isip su-para mea epaade pare nipu aa-para puma palo maarea lisimi.
Go lisimi rabu nimumi remo mena gawa-rupa warisimi. Nimumi pa kimi warili mena gawa madaa gote ma-aulaaomaa rana ranaa komo pirisimi.

Go rabu Gote-me nimu yaa-para aatade kuba kedonuna bi minasaainalo giyesa. Go madaare Gote-na agale lakale alinumi buk madaa gu-rupa lu wisimi: Nimi Israel su-para piri enaalinu-ya. Nimimi maali 40 su kamaa piruma mena gawanu luma lodo kirisimide-le gore ni-para pisimi pae? Ora dia.

Nimimi mo remo Molek-na mamina warili abala mea kilipima ria pisimi. Go raapu mo remo Refan-na kuba kedo page minasaasimi. Go remo wasaare nimimi waria kiritasimi. Go pumare neme nimi Babilon su-para maa pua mapiraalua lisa. Profet alimi buk madaa apo agale lu wisa.
Stiven-me agale pena lala lisa: Naana kasuanuri enaali napiri su-para piruma lotu ada sel laplap-me warisimi. Go adare Gote-me Moses-para wariape lo robo wisa-rupa warisimi.

Werepe go laplap-me warili adare kasuanumi sinu-para kalaama puma kasuanumi kilipima ru pisimi. Go puma Josua-me ruru radonu raita maa pisa rabu kasuanu sel ada go-para ma ria pisimi. Go pulalo pisimi rabu Gote-me lore alinu abala ralu rubesa. Go su-parare Devit madisa rabu page sel ada wisa.
Devit-ri Gote-me epe ali kone wisa-pulu nipumi Gote-para ne ora kasua Jekop-na Gote yaa-pulu nena pirape lotu ada warialuame pi lo beten lisa.
Go beten lisa pare Devit-na naaki King Solomon nipumi go lotu ada warisa.
Yapare so Adaa Gote-re pa kimi warili ada-para napia. Go madaare Gote-na agale lakale alimi gu-rupa lisa:
Mudu Alimi gu-rupa lisa: Yaa-parare ora nina piri siaa yaade. No suri ora nina age wi-para yaade. Go pe-le nimimi nina adare ake pu palimi yapae? Go page nina Pomo mu Pirape su yaade.
Neme go elenuri nina kimi waritu lisa.
Stiven-me kaunsil gu-rupa lakalisa: Nimiri pupitagi no raa-para piri enaali pimi. Nimina kale poaoma Gote-na agale napageme. Nimiri nimina kasuanumi Holi Spirit giyasimide-rupa peme.
Profet ora komea nimina kasuanumi radaa nakalasimi ya? Go page nimina kasuanumi epe redepo le ali madaa pora mea waalape ali lu makomasimi. Go puma abi page nimimi nipu koe maduma lu makomasimi.
Nimiri ensel-me Gote-na rekena agale mea lagisa. Go pisa pare nimimi go agale yokoma napagaeme.
Nimumi Stiven kaname lu makomaasimi
Kaunsil piri alinumi Stiven-na agale pagomare waru rono pagesimi-pulu nimuna kabulu regepe no pirisimi.
Yapare Stiven-re Holi Spirit nipuna lo robaa-para rubitabesa-pulu nipumi so yaa-para Gote-na epe paa adisa. Yesu Gote-na popo ki-nane pirina adisa.
Adalepa. So yaa lobapaina Gote-na ki popa ki-nane enaali Raapu Pirape alina Si so pia-daa lo Stiven-me gu-rupa lisa.
Go lisa rabu nimumi ali-ya loma nimuna kale pora poaoma Stiven wagepu adialalo pirisimi.
Nimumi nipu adare kamaa-nane raita maa puma kaname lisimi. Go puma nipu lu makomaape alinumi mamina kaloma penaali meda mea kalisimi. Go alina biri Sol yaade.
Nimumi kaname talaina Stiven-me Gote-para beten gu-rupa lisa: Mudu Ali Yesu, nina wasupa mea lisa.
Go lisa rabu rumu pege puma agale puri paloma lisa: Mudu Ali, go alinuna pupitagi koe kedaa na-abulape. Go loma nipu komoma u palisa.
